rca of the issue: Bottom-nav overlap RCA: OurRealm's mobile-style bottom nav (Home/For You/Sounds/Plus/Realms/Friends/Profile) renders on ALL viewports (verified in Course Player screenshot at 1440x900). Its z-index is > the FAB (iter-104) and >= the tutor-panel footer, so document.elementFromPoint at buttons near bottom-of-viewport resolves to the bottom-nav icon instead of the intended button. Mitigation options: (a) hide bottom nav on desktop (md:hidden), OR (b) raise page-level floating buttons to z-index above the nav, OR (c) add sufficient bottom padding to Course Player/RC ORAi content so the interactive controls sit above the nav strip.
